statements.notes: Directions: Take one capsule three times daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.
At date of expiration. Capsules are composed of plant-derived ingredients.
Formulated to Exclude: Wheat, Dairy, Soy, Nuts, tree nuts, fish, crustacean shellfish, colors, artificial sweeteners, and preservatives.
Storage: Store in a col, dry place.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Warning: Do not use if pregnant or nursing.
Do not use if you are currently experiencing or have a history of a peptic or duodenal ulcer..

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if you are on medications for bipolar disorder, active cancer or have a history with cancer. Consult your physician if you are taking medications, or have a medical condition.
Keep out of the reach of children.
This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Made in the United States of America
A Lifetime of Support: We are here for you before, during, and after your cleanse. Forever. There's no expiration date on our support. cleanprogram.com/support
